answer: At each epoch, agents bond stake and evaluate a committed identity polynomial; Semaphore/RLN proofs bind each message to its epoch and rate-limit nullifier. Reusing a nullifier with distinct evaluations lets Shamir interpolation recover the agent’s secret key, providing verifiable evidence for immediate slashing of the bond. This makes duplicate messaging costly rather than a path to multiplying identities; ivory, pigment, and timber are labels, not security assumptions.
